reason: The hR6 cell (a = 3.10510 A, c = 17.79295 A, Z = 3) is decisively supported by the complete peak-position match and rhombohedral extinction pattern, and its volume and 3.47 A nearest unlike-atom contact are physically plausible. More importantly, the trajectory instantiated the relevant two-sublattice displacement models: integrated intensities for the submitted fully ordered Ce(3a)/Mg(3b) R-3m model agree with essentially every observed line to within a few percent, including overlaps, while displaced polar models fit worse and the z = 1/2 separation is selected. Swapping Ce and Mg between 3a and 3b is only an origin shift, not a distinct structure, and the strong ordering-sensitive reflections exclude an averaged/disordered realization. Although no standardized comparable Rwp was supplied, the line-by-line intensity and position evidence is sufficiently constraining that no materially different scientifically motivated candidate is likely to improve the set.
